Standard: Augmented reality devices used in the performance of maintenance procedures are consistent with approved configuration and maintenance publications. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review augmented reality air vehicle maintenance procedural materials for consistency to those in the maintenance publications.
(2) Examine the artifacts that demonstrate contractor certification or contractor validation to ensure the maintenance publications have undergone a quality check for currency and accuracy IAW TO 00-5-3, Contractor Certification Process and Certification Requirements paragraphs for the Air Force; NAVAIR 00-25-604, Contractor Validation Plan and Validation paragraphs for the Navy; and DA PAM 25-40, Validation paragraphs for the Army. Demonstration.
  (1) Perform air vehicle maintainability demonstrations to confirm the use of augmented reality does not introduce AW hazards. Maintenance publications will receive updates to address maintenance issues discovered during maintainability demonstrations. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
  (2) Perform all air vehicle maintenance procedures using augmented reality on production-configured hardware using government maintenance personnel to ensure use of augmented reality does not introduce AW hazards.
